name: agent-fs-tools-decisions
body: The filesystem tool suite `apg_rm`, `apg_mv`, and `apg_cp` is installed by `apg init` as opencode 2.x plugins. Each tool self-enforces per-path scope: it resolves the target path against the caller's project directory and refuses a path outside the acting agent's granted globs under the opencode 2.x `permissions` model. The tool-level permission (the `apg_rm`/`apg_mv`/`apg_cp` action, deny-by-default) is the tool's callability gate; per-path matching happens inside the tool, since opencode treats a custom tool's path argument as opaque. For the two-argument tools both source and destination match the granted globs. The scope is remove, move, and copy; code-writers hold no `shell` filesystem-mutation grant for these operations. The way a tool learns the acting agent's identity under opencode 2.x is the accepted open item of `requirements.constraint.agent-fs-per-path-permission`, verified by unit/int tests against a faked V2 tool context. An unresolvable acting agent refuses every path.
